limitations: Mapping of ex1-ex5 to groups is taken from paper section 2.8 ('exosome 1-3', 'exosome 4-5'), assuming exosome N = exN; no deposited mapping file exists.
Paper/PRIDE text says three biological replicates, but only two infected files (ex4, ex5) are deposited; replicates numbered within group.
Developmental stage, sex, cell type not stated: not available. Strain 'SalmoBreed standard' is free text (ontology warning only).
Disease for infected samples uses EFO 'Piscirickettsiaceae Infections' (no exact MONDO term for piscirickettsiosis found); healthy = PATO 'normal'.
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated in paper/PRIDE; columns omitted (carbamidomethyl fixed mod comes from the Mascot search). Deposited .mgf/.dat files are search artefacts, not raw files.
Fragment tolerance 0.1 Da from Mascot dat; the paper states 0.8 Da for the X!Tandem search. Sample searches also included Homo sapiens taxonomy field in Mascot header (DB=UniProt_SalmoSalar).
